wiki.title: Brad Schneider
wiki.extract: Bradley Scott Schneider (born August 20, 1961) is an American businessman and politician who has served as the U.S. representative for Illinois's 10th congressional district since 2017 and previously from 2013 to 2015. The district is dominated by the northern suburbs of Chicago along Lake Michigan. He is a member of the Democratic Party.
